payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Judge whether the image reads as a chalk drawing, rather than relying on graininess, blur, or softened outlines alone. Complete: the image reads as a chalk drawing. Partial: there is visible progress toward a chalk drawing, but it does not yet read as one. Absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. Unknown: evidence is insufficient to judge. Do not impose requirements beyond the requested chalk-drawing transformation; unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: the image. Requested transformation: a drawing made from chalk.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
